<item>
  <title>Purge Cassette Recall: Abiomed Removes Impella Heart Pump Purge Cassettes</title>
  <link>http://www.fda.gov/medical-devices/medical-device-recalls-and-early-alerts/purge-cassette-recall-abiomed-removes-impella-heart-pump-purge-cassettes</link>
  <description>Impella Generation 1 Purge Cassettes have an increased risk of purge leaks. Purge leaks can lead to low pump pressure and pump stops.</description>

    </item>

  <title>Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC Issues Voluntary Nationwide Recall of Magnesium Sulfate in Water for Injection, USP 4 g/100mL (NDC 70121-1720-3) Due to a Product Mix-up with Tranexamic Acid in 0.7% Sodium Chloride Injection, 10 mg/mL</title>
  <link>http://www.fda.gov/safety/recalls-market-withdrawals-safety-alerts/amneal-pharmaceuticals-llc-issues-voluntary-nationwide-recall-magnesium-sulfate-water-injection-usp</link>
  <description>Bridgewater, New Jersey, Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC is voluntarily recalling one lot of Magnesium Sulfate in Water for Injection, USP, 4g/100mL, IV bag, to the hospital level. A Magnesium Sulfate in Water for Injection pouch was found to contain an IV bag of Tranexamic Acid in 0.7% Sodium Chloride I</description>
  <pubDate>Tue, 24 Mar 2026 00:00:00 EDT</pubDate>

    <guid isPermaLink="true">http://www.fda.gov/safety/recalls-market-withdrawals-safety-alerts/amneal-pharmaceuticals-llc-issues-voluntary-nationwide-recall-magnesium-sulfate-water-injection-usp</guid>

<item>
  <title>Cardinal Health Issues Voluntary Nationwide Recall of Webcol™ Large Alcohol Prep Pad</title>
  <link>http://www.fda.gov/safety/recalls-market-withdrawals-safety-alerts/cardinal-health-issues-voluntary-nationwide-recall-webcoltm-large-alcohol-prep-pad</link>
  <description>DUBLIN, Ohio, March 19, 2026 – Cardinal Health has issued a voluntary recall for select lots of Webcol™ Large Alcohol Prep Pads (70% isopropyl alcohol) to the consumer level. The product is being recalled due to microbial contamination identified as Paenibacillus phoenicis.</description>
  <pubDate>Fri, 20 Mar 2026 00:00:00 EDT</pubDate>
    <dc:creator>FDA</dc:creator>
    <guid isPermaLink="true">http://www.fda.gov/safety/recalls-market-withdrawals-safety-alerts/cardinal-health-issues-voluntary-nationwide-recall-webcoltm-large-alcohol-prep-pad</guid>
    </item>
